data.one_liner: Native implementation for video playback in package:media_kit.
data.what_it_does: Provides native video rendering and playback capabilities for package:media_kit across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You are using media_kit for media playback and need video rendering components.
You want native video implementation across cross-platform targets including desktop and mobile.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard Flutter video_player package.
strengths: Cross-platform support including desktop and mobile
weaknesses: Requires media_kit as an underlying dependency
Limited standalone documentation available in the provided README
data.setup_notes: Requires adding package:media_kit and its associated setup requirements.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter plugin for video playback if you do not want to use media_kit.

alternatives.name: chewie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive set of material and cupertino video controls on top of video_player.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary requirement is advanced audio playback rather than video.
